# Local scan dependencies

Tesseract.js 7.0.0 and Tesseract.js-core 7.0.0 are distributed under Apache-2.0. The standalone baseline LSTM WebAssembly build runs in a worker. See TESSERACT-LICENSE.md, CORE-LICENSE and the bundle notices.

The English model comes from tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast (Apache-2.0). The Japanese model comes from @tesseract.js-data/jpn 1.0.0, 4.0.0_best_int (Apache-2.0).

jsQR 1.4.0 is distributed under Apache-2.0. See JSQR-LICENSE.

The English and Japanese print indexes contain collector numbers and names grouped by set ID, sourced from https://api.tcgdex.net/v2/en/cards and https://api.tcgdex.net/v2/ja/cards. See TCGDEX-LICENSE. These reference data files contain no card artwork.
